privacy.settingHint: On: your ascents appear on the “Recent ascents” list in News — showing your full name, route, grade, style, area and date — and your coach can see your logbook in the admin panel. Turning it off removes them from both at once. Comments, attempt counts and ratings are never published. If your coach runs your training calendar, they see your logbook regardless of this setting.
